blockedTests.name: EdDSA Ed25519 verification with transferred signature during call
blockedTests.reason: The getter transfers its buffer on both name reads. WebCrypto §18.4.4 steps 2 and 6 plus WebIDL §3.2.17 require both conversions, so the second transfer throws. Upstream confirms this specification/test disagreement in w3c/webcrypto#563; original case retained unchanged.
